desc: Identify oversized files and mega-component issues
context: Check all 63 files in the ui-components zone. Flag any files over 300 lines. For large components (> 200 lines), assess whether they are doing too many things and could be decomposed into smaller components. Pay special attention to pages/ directory which often becomes bloated.
acceptance_criteria: Files between 200-300 lines assessed for decomposability
Mega-components with too many responsibilities identified
Specific decomposition suggestions included where obvious
